pick.headline: Moscow admits the NKVD carried out the Katyn massacre
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of April 13, 1990, carried Warsaw PAP in English: the USSR had admitted the NKVD murdered some 15,000 Polish officers at Katyn, calling it 'one of the most horrifying Stalinist crimes', as relayed via the BBC and Moscow radio.
